description: This file defines an Android Fragment (CameraFragment) and an inner class (Preview) for handling camera preview functionality within an Android application. It manages camera selection, lifecycle events, and preview display for a custom camera interface.

classes.name: CameraFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that manages camera hardware, handles camera lifecycle, and provides options for switching cameras.

classes.name: Preview
classes.description: A custom ViewGroup that encapsulates camera preview display and manages SurfaceView lifecycle, sizing, and camera parameter configuration.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes camera preview and determines default camera id based on available cameras.

methods.name: onActivityCreated
methods.description: Configures action bar behavior after activity creation.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Returns the Preview view as this fragment's main view.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Opens the current camera and starts preview when the fragment resumes.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Releases the camera resource when the fragment is paused.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates camera switch menu if multiple cameras are available.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu actions including switching between cameras and navigating home.
